text:
maria: FYI Support escalated a BeaconPay incident — they report sharp p99 spikes on /v1/generate (prod-text-1) starting ~2145674500. Can ops take a look?
aj: I see the spike on the SLO dashboard: p95 from ~160ms to ~430ms, p99 from ~480ms to ~2.2s over the last 40m. Error-rate low but increased client retries.
devon: customer logs (sanitized) show repeated allocator failures and fallback: 
```n2026-04-10T09:05:12Z ERR GPUOOM while resizing kv cache; fallback to sync path
2026-04-10T09:05:12Z WARN falling back to slow path; elapsed=2.3s
```
They report some 503s during the peak. Workload unchanged: lots of long-context requests (3k-4k tokens), mixed streaming.
sri: this smells like KV cache growth + allocator fragmentation. Similar incident in Dec where long-lived KV + uneven batch sizes caused many small free fragments and transient OOMs that forced slow codepaths.
maria: infra, any host-side OOM traces?
aj: grepped runtime logs for GPUOOM across prod-text-1 fleet: 
```nworker-11: 2026-04-10T09:02:48 GPUOOM: cudamalloc failed while expanding kv buffer
worker-19: 2026-04-10T09:04:55 GPUOOM: failed to allocate 128MB for kv page
```
nvidia-smi snapshot from host-b: memory 58GiB/80GiB but many small free segments reported by allocator telemetry.
infra-bot: @channel runtime_p99 alert fired for prod-text-1 at 2145674603 (rule: runtime_p99 > 1.0s).
maria: short-term mitigations to try now: throttle max_tokens at gateway for that tenant, steer new sessions to redwood-small-v1 (smaller KV), restart a small subset of workers to clear fragmented allocations, and set allocator tuning on restart.
aj: starting canary restart of 10% of prod-text-1 pods with env toggles: CLEAR_KV_ON_START=1 and PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=max_split_size_mb:64. Running: `kubectl -n runtime rollout restart deployment/prod-text-1 --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"runtime","env":[{"name":"CLEAR_KV_ON_START","value":"1"},{"name":"PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF","value":"max_split_size_mb:64"}]}]}}}}'`
deploy-bot: initiated rollout patch-2145678000 -> 3 pods updating.
sri: recommend also applying a short KV eviction TTL and per-session soft cap to limit unbounded growth while we investigate.
devon: notified BeaconPay: temporary gateway cap to 2k tokens for new requests and routing to small model for new sessions. They agreed to test.
aj: canary metrics after 8 pods rolled: canary p99 dropped from 2.2s -> 650ms. No GPUOOMs in canary logs. Starting remainder rollout.
maria: good. sri, push KV throttles now (15m retention + session entry cap 32)?
sri: pushed kv config: {"kv_retention_minutes":"15","kv_max_entries_per_session":"32"} via config agent; applied to prod cluster. Added alert: kv_entries_per_session > 64 for 10m.
Commands for debug/repro (dev/debug team):
```n# simulate long context KV growth (local reproduce)
python tools/sim_kv_growth.py --model redwood-large-v1 --prompt-tokens 3500 --concurrency 6 --duration 900

# query fragmentation metric
curl -s 'http://metrics:9090/api/v1/query?query=runtime_gpu_fragmentation_percent' | jq '.'
```
aj: rollout completed @2145678300. Cluster p99 for prod-text-1 averaged ~580ms over last 10m. No further GPUOOM entries.
sri: fragmentation metric down ~12% after restarts + allocator hint. KV growth rate for BeaconPay tenant fell from ~1.1M entries/hr -> ~0.28M entries/hr.
devon: BeaconPay confirms latency dramatically improved and 503s stopped. Customer: "Thanks, latency back to normal, appreciate the quick help." :thumbsup: 
maria: follow-ups for durable fixes: enforce per-tenant KV hard caps + soft TTLs in runtime; implement periodic KV compaction to coalesce free chunks; expose per-model fragmentation and avg_free_chunk_size in Console; default allocator tuning (max_split_size_mb:64) rollout with canary; add CI load test that mimics long-prompt KV churn.
sri: I'll own compaction and telemetry (ETA 3w). aj will lead allocator default rollout (ETA 1w, with canary). maria to write incident summary and postmortem.
maria: incident created INF-2145 and linked to customer thread. Postmortem ping scheduled in #postmortems in 48h.
action items:
- aj: validate p99 stable after 30m and close the immediate rollback (ETA 30m)
- sri: persist KV config, add alert & start compaction design (ETA 3w)
- devon: confirm with BeaconPay after 30m and capture any remaining repro
- maria: draft postmortem and customer comms

maria: thanks team. Closing this thread after postmortem is posted. Great triage and mitigation work. :rocket:
